Zekrom

Dragon Electric

Unova · Generation 5 · Legendary Pokémon

Zekrom is a Dragon/Electric-type Deep Black Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 2.9 m tall and weighs 345 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (150), with a base stat total of 680.
